lead.description: an inquiry that puts the same questions to a selected part of a population and generalises

overview_sentence: A [statistical survey](articles/statistical-survey.qmd) asks a selected part of a population and generalises.

self_checks.title: Sample proportion
self_checks.prompt: Of 50 drawn households, 35 have a working alarm, from a city of 1000. What is the sample proportion?

self_checks.title: Larger draw
self_checks.prompt: Of 80 households, 60 have a working alarm. What are the sample proportion and the sampling fraction out of 1000?
self_checks.answer: The sample proportion is 0.75 and the sampling fraction is 0.08.
